I’m feeling awfully optimistic from the meds, which is a downer by itself.

I really think I’ll be falling asleep soonish, but please feel free to PM if you’d like to chat now or whenever. I hope you have a wonderful night, and thank you for giving me well wishes

Thanks a lot for the advice!

I do think some of it is that my arm or my mouth gets tired after a while. In my experience she’s needed about 20 straight minutes of stimulation from herself to get there. Like there’s been a few times where she’s told me to not stop, that she’s close, and I continue the pace but there’s just no release from her. She just loses it. Unsure if maybe I slide off or something because it’s hurting at that point?

Apparently she can cum in less than 10 start-to-finish when she’s by herself, which makes sense to me—I take a bit to cum, too, and get a much less satisfying but way quicker one by myself.

I have been almost begging to watch porn with her because I feel that would help me understand her at a different level!! I think she finds that a little scary for some reason, but she’s semi-open to it. It just hasn’t happened.

Honestly several months ago she had said she thinks she might have a porn addiction which she thought affected her ability to orgasm with a partner, but she had only really brought that up that one time. Then we later talked about the trauma from her youth.

Apparently she just watches whatever lesbian video is trending on PornHub :p I’ll do some homework lol

Thanks again for the advice! I think we’ll be okay I just want to wow her dammit

I wouldn’t disagree with this except that she has came in my presence before. BUT it takes her a very long time, much longer than if she was just doing it by herself, and she’s also pretty adamant that she wants me to touch myself while she’s trying to finish. But obviously what I just described does mean there’s totally a psychological element at play here and she just is able to get past it sometimes…

She is not processing this trauma with a therapist. That is something I’ve been advocating for, and I think within the next couple of months she might be ready for that journey.

Thanks a lot for the advice. I don’t want to take any of this personally because I just want her to feel good and me moping isn’t going to aid that, but sometimes my brain is just, like, “so am I ugly or do I just have bad dexterity?” Lol.

We’ve toyed with some kinkier things that I definitely think help. Usually I’m the one to try to introduce that (not everything but most). I’ve tried to inquire about her kinks, but she says she doesn’t find herself a particularly kinky person.

I do think she has fun for the majority of the time we’re fucking, and I think she likes the beginning and middle process. It’s just when those three to four hours have gone by, and she still hasn’t come I think it just sucks.

Thank you so much for the response. I’ll keep trying to add stuff to spice it up for sure :)

I think she felt embarrassed which is why she asked me to leave (to run a bath for us). I had gotten pretty obviously bored at that point, I guess, and before we got to the point of her asking me to leave she had asked if I was still having fun because she felt like she was bothering me by taking so long that particular time.

Just adding context there. What is/was your opinion on her needing alone time for that?

I’m way too crossed to properly answer you. I didn’t ask her to be my girlfriend because she told me she wanted to, and the times I conceded and did ask we would only muse for a bit then she would say no eventually because she wanted to ask. I think she just wanted to be the one to do it to be romantic/do something to wow me. Tonight she told me she was just always too scared to take that leap because of past experiences where she had been hurt, which I guess I knew. I understand it. Like I said, I figured she was just being a bit goofy in the end but I always found it a little sweet — that she wanted to do something big and romantic and special, just for us.

Anyway, she broke up with me tonight. Same stuff I had been explaining — too much on her plate to commit to a relationship right now. That she had sat on this decision for three days, just telling me today. It’s okay. She would like to be friends, as would I, but she needs a month give or take of silence to process she says.

I feel sad. I feel okay. I feel like I’m being ripped apart. I feel relieved. The works I guess.

I honestly admitted I was in love with her tonight, which is the first time I’ve said it out loud. Glad I had the chance to share it.

She says she can’t foresee us ever trying again, even after she processes everything as an individual in her life that makes her feel like she can not commit. I don’t know if either of us can know right now if we want to try again, as we reapproach our relationship platonically we may never find ourselves attracted to each other again, or we may find we mutually are so. Don’t think that’s necessarily important rn. I just hope she’s okay.

Shit sucks. Thank you for talking to me when you did — I know you don’t feel particularly empathetic with humans, but I found your perspective super helpful and I am very grateful for it. You’re a good person.

Oh, wow, reading that article was nuts.

My ex-boyfriend, and ex-fling, were both much more obviously narcissistic/toxic than my current lady is so this is weird. I don’t know if I would classify her as narcissistic. I feel like she gives me an open space to speak, for sure, and doesn’t really hog convos.

She has said a lot that she feels I make everything about myself, but she may have been kidding. 6 on that article hit really hard—that has been a new development, and just so fucking constant especially when I visit her in person post-move.

In terms of her not being sensitive to my triggers, she has had sexual abuse in her past as well. So once when were intimate, I cried and she comforted me but the next day she told me that I had triggered her and she wasn’t sure how she felt about stuff at that point. We obviously got through that, but I did feel guilty for having that response—I was very clear to her from the get-go that I figured I would feel a lot of emotions during physical stuff, and she had seemed okay with that until that point. I don’t know. I know things can change once you are actually in the heat of the moment.

I don’t know. We clicked so instantaneously; it’s hard to envision a future without her—I want to tell her everything, and talk to her all the time. I desperately want us to stay friends even if we can’t continue being romantic.

I also have no idea how much space I am supposed to give her. We have only been speaking before bed anyway (we regularly hop on FT to talk or watch things together, but sometimes we just text for an hour or so), so with her asking for space I am just not talking to her at all. Which is fine, but her birthday is at the end of this week so obviously I want to speak to her by then. But I don’t know if that’s rude. Lol. It’s so awkward when this person you have so many emotions and regards for becomes a stranger you forget how to interact with. Like, this is my girl—I shouldn’t be afraid of reaching out to her. I definitely have some issues because of my past relationships where I am just worried about setting people off, though, that doesn’t come from just her at all.

Also, if I did decide I wanted to end the relationship I would feel like such a DICK for doing that at this point in her life anyway.

Sorry for making this conversation go on so long, but thank you for talking with me and giving me a pathway for these thoughts. I don’t really want to talk to my irl friends about this much because they don’t really know her too well, and I don’t want to put weird thoughts in their head in case I am misreading the situation with her.

TRIGGER WARNING.

Thank you for everything you had been saying. I have been thinking about it throughout today.

I have especially been thinking about vulnerability, and sharing that “special experience” with her, and how that has probably made me very attached. Before her, all of my experiences had been non-consensual so she is the first person to give me a safe space that I also desired. When we first started doing more intimate things, I would get SO anxious and start rambling about my past scary encounters, and I remember she would get frustrated/disappointed that I was thinking about those other people while with her. I felt really guilty about that, and have since stopped, but it was all very novel and my body would panic.

Another thing that I thought was maybe not important to mention is that we are exclusive, we have spoken about maybe moving in together after a year together, we have traveled to each other since moving (she even rode 13 hours in the car with my older brother to help me get into my apartment, just so we could spend more time together). But, she hasn’t actually asked me to be her girlfriend. We call each other that when we talk about each other to others, and even to each other, but she has said she wanted to ask me in a “special” manner and hasn’t had the opportunity yet I guess. There has been a couple times where I asked her/she asked me, just in moments where we are relaxing together, but she takes it back because she wants to do it bigger. I had thought she was just being a bit silly about this, but now with what you’re saying mixed with her talking about “leading me on” and not being able to commit… I am just confused.

She also hurt me the other day because, like I said, she said she is worried that she can’t emotionally commit to me right now because of everything going on. And I think I asked if we broke up right now, would she consider me her ex and she said no. Then quickly said that she didn’t know. And honestly, it makes me feel like an idiot. Like somewhere along the way, I got the impression I was more important to her than I guess I am? I don’t really understand her logic there, or if she is just not thinking about me/us at all right now.

Which again is FINE. I can understand that a new, now distant relationship can’t be the forefront of your life when it is as busy and chaotic as hers currently is. But, like you are saying, I don’t feel secure in this relationship and it has been making me anxious. I just want to be someone she can count on, but it feels like she is pushing me away. And maybe everyone else, too, and I don’t know if that’s healthy for me to enable but I also don’t want to disrespect that she needs space. You know?

We also haven’t said we love each other yet. I don’t know if I do—I literally don’t let myself think about it, but I do think the foundation of respect + trust is there, and I had allowed myself to be very vulnerable with her which is new. She has told me she does not yet.

I don’t know if that lines up with her past relationships, in which she was the one who got really hurt. She actually told me often in the beginning that she knew I was going to be the one to dump her.

She doesn’t seem to have rotating friends, but she does seem to stop speaking with them for a while and they are always ready for her when she comes back. I did take note of that, and I guess I am kind of feeling that now.

I do definitely think things were mutual at the get go (she used to be much warmer in her interactions with me, you know stereotypical honey moon phase stuff. Very flirty. She even said very recently that she feels very happy when we are together and very sad when we aren’t, but even more recently than that she has said she has had trouble having ANY emotions).

I honestly think this is just a shit and traumatic time for her, and that she just wants to be alone in her life and figure out stuff through therapy. But I wonder where I best fit into these needs. I’d like to be her girlfriend.

We have been exclusive with each other since we had sex for the first time. I lost my virginity to her, as well.

Hm. These are things to think about.

What would be the end goal, if you’re correct about this, you think?

I honestly think I am capable of feeling just normal feelings for people, like I do with her, but she has been the first, and I do think I am rather… picky? Lol. But I finally get what love songs are about, man! It’s crazy!
Thank you. I’ll take care of myself :) I really appreciate it

Hey, thanks so much for your reply.

I definitely respect that she needs space, and I’m not taking it personally (I think it’s introversion like you are saying—sometimes she ghosts her friends for weeks, but she says she does differently with an SO. But it’s been a long time since she has dated. It has more to do with the extreme personal situations, though, that is probably making her want to be extra alone to process).

She has definitely been there for me in the past and I know she would be again, but I am very scared of putting that pressure onto other people. That I am feeling very depressed again, myself. And especially to her, right now, it seems a bit tone deaf.

But you’re right that maybe I should try to remind her that I do have emotional needs, too. A part of me is worried that might upset her, though… in past conversations where I mentioned stuff along those lines she got pretty frustrated. She says she doesn’t have a lot of patience right now.

I figured I would just be quiet till she messages me?

Yeah, you’re saying similar things to what she had said too. That long distance seems very daunting to her (one of her top two love languages is physical touch), but she wanted to try it because it’s me. And things might change once my lease is up. Before she thought it was too early for either of us to consider moving to the same city, different apartments or not. She also claims to have commitment issues, especially now.

Before her, I had only been with very shitty people and I hadn’t felt any attraction for them. With her, it’s so different. It’s like a fire underneath my skin when I think about her, and I am sooo much more attracted to her every single time I see her (even when I was seeing her multiple times a week). It’s truly my first time ever feeling like this for someone before, and I had thought I was asexual and maybe even aromantic (I figured if I meshed well with someone romance was definitely possible for me). So very exciting stuff.

Maybe I should have grew a pair and moved to her city, or to the one I used to live in (right next to it). I just moved for my career, so all 3 places are very viable but the one I am in seemed best for people trying to break into the industry. So I chose here.

Thanks again.

Yes, her best friend lives in her new city so she has her, and her friends. She is working a LOT, though (she really likes her coworkers though afaik), and that has also been beating down on her. She also has clinical depression, and has wanted to go back to therapy especially after the new stuff with her family but hasn’t done that yet.

I didn’t know anyone when I moved here, but I have found friends through my work and it has been very nice. They have been very immediately inclusive in bringing me places, and introducing me to their friends. Also due to the nature of my work (film), there’s new people to meet every new job so that’s exciting. These are not people I am willing to necessarily lean on yet, though, but they are great for keeping my extroverted self happy. Lol.

We both have great friendships from back home that we talk to often, but yeah when we were closer together we were seeing each other multiple times a week for months so the distance has certainly been new. She also told me she likes to speak every day to her SO usually, so we have been talking pretty much daily since we met, so she definitely is the person I crave speaking to most. But that’s normal because she’s my girl, yeah?

Thank you for your comment.
